relationship.label: overlapping
relationship.description: The datasets cover an identical set of company-quarter keys.

recommended_merge_strategy.rationale: The two datasets describe the SAME company-quarter keys but 100.0% of shared rows carry conflicting values. Silently stacking would create ambiguous duplicate keys, and picking one source discards real signal. The safest option that preserves all information is to keep both and tag provenance with a `source` column, making the panel key (source, Company, Year, Quarter). 'prefer_real' is the more conservative single-record alternative.
recommended_merge_strategy.warning: Do NOT blindly stack: shared keys with conflicting values would otherwise become undetected duplicate company-quarter records.

build_decisions.strategy_detail: Both sources retained with provenance tag; effective panel key is (source, Company, Year, Quarter).

no_duplicate_company_quarter.info: 80 rows share (Company, Year, Quarter) across sources — expected by design under source_tagged_pool; each is uniquely identified by adding the 'source' provenance tag.

no_broken_accounting_identities.note: Identities are validated on the merged data. The builder never recomputes financials, so any violation is inherited from the source datasets, not introduced by merging.

no_obvious_leakage.note: Value-identical column pairs are reported for awareness; in these datasets some balance-sheet fields may coincide by construction. They are flagged so feature engineering in Phase 3 can avoid using redundant columns, but are not necessarily errors.
